capabilities: insert callouts with title and fold option via command
change an existing callout's type from a picker
add 20 extra callout colors with icons
define custom callouts (id, label, color, icon) in settings
extras: Discloses that it works entirely offline with no network requests, no telemetry, and no account; all custom callout data is stored locally.
intentEvidence: Pick callout colors and types from a visual menu instead of typing the identifier by hand.
problem: Obsidian's callout syntax requires remembering exact type keywords and offers no visual menu or built-in way to add more colors or custom callout types without CSS.
summary: Callout helper that adds a visual picker with live preview for callout types and colors, plus 20 extra colors and custom callouts.
